_comment: v4: intents are priced through INTENT_SCALE in rewards.py (kill / damage_dealt / damage_taken / team_win / time scaled per intent) rather than through an added shaping term, which three seeds showed does nothing for push, hold_angle and trade. The clock is on here because `push` is the only intent that pays it (scale 1; the others 0). Every key is spelled out: --reward-json merges onto RewardConfig defaults.
